items.title: Pudgy Penguins' Ethereum Layer-2 Abstract Is Shutting Down
items.body: Abstract will shut down Dec. 15, saying a chain focused solely on consumer crypto proved unsustainable, and is urging users to bridge their assets off before then.

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade launches on Sepolia testnet
items.body: Sepolia marks one of the final major rehearsals before the final activation of Glamsterdam, aimed at bringing more efficiency and scalability to the Ethereum mainnet.

items.title: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
items.body: The Ethereum layer-2 is backing Paxos-issued USDG to earn a share of reserve income as new stablecoin alliances compete for distribution, users and reserve economics.

items.title: EEZ tests atomic L1-to-L2 transaction in push to unify Ethereum
items.body: An EEZ contributor shared a 0.001 ETH cross-chain test as the project develops a framework to connect Ethereum mainnet and its rollups.

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam test gets last-minute fix before major capacity jump
items.body: One of Ethereum’s main validator clients updated its software hours before a Sepolia test that will raise the amount of work each block can hold to 200 million gas.

items.title: Bitmine Buys $41M More Ethereum, Reaching 99% of Its 'Alchemy of 5%' Target
items.body: The purchase lifts Bitmine's stash past 6 million ETH—4.9% of supply and 99% of the way to its "Alchemy of 5%" goal—as chairman Tom Lee says Ethereum is "dwarfing" other macro assets.
